notes: Data-generation job creation remains a beta project operation in azure-ai-projects 2.7.0; the notebook uses the SDK's native poller instead of a manual loop.
The custom structural tool-call evaluator runs through the stable azure-ai-evaluation package; no cloud evaluation poller is required for this local target/evaluator flow.

azure-ai-projects 2.7.0 exposes project-scoped deployment get/list operations but not deployment creation, so the notebook validates an existing fine-tuned deployment instead of using an account-level control-plane request.
The final run emitted non-blocking Windows Jupyter transport warnings.
